period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing) — chosen per this project's stated preference for Solo over Consolidated wherever both are available. Matches the basis of this bank's 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series (2020 Q4/annual is Consolidated per that entry's own note, so do not compare this quarter's absolute levels directly against 2020_Q4.json without adjusting for the bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect). Balance sheet identity reconciles to within BDT 1 (rounding): Total property and assets 357,346,328,028 vs Total liabilities 318,450,909,334 + Total shareholders' equity 38,895,418,693 = 357,346,328,027. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Notes 3.2a/4.2a of the source disclose a pro-forma NAV (BDT 29.34) and EPS (BDT 0.81) 'considering' a 7.5% stock dividend for FY2019 that was still pending shareholder approval (21st AGM, 25 June 2020) as of this filing's date — this file uses the as-filed, non-restated NAV (31.54) and EPS (0.87) actually reported for the period, not the pro-forma figures. Solo Key Financial Ratios (note 6.3, annualized) give car_pct/roa_pct/roe_pct directly; no NPL% or cost-income ratio is disclosed anywhere in this filing. COVID-19 finding: note 4.3 states standalone/consolidated EPS 'reduced significantly mainly due to less income earned for COVID-19 pandemic particularly commission and fees income as well as increased operating expenditure and provision requirement against loans and advances and off balance sheet exposures'; note 5.3 separately attributes the drop in Net Operating Cash Flow Per Share to 'decrease in deposits and borrowings from customers and banks as COVID-19 pandemic spread out in Bangladesh' and to 'central bank's circular for postponing the collection of loan installments from customers' (i.e. the BB loan-moratorium circular) — no separate NPL/asset-quality note beyond this cash-flow commentary.
